title: [spec-gap][R-07-031] C congestion thresholds 700/850/950 diverge from spec/Py/Rust 500/800/950; C 5.03 builder has no production caller
description: spec/07-transport-app.md:550-555 congestion tiers: Normal <50%, Elevated 50-80%, Critical 80-95%, Exhausted >95% (500/800/950 permille). Python conforms: coap/params.py:140-148 thresholds 500/800/950 + congestion_service_unavailable :239-292 (5.03 + Max-Age=retry_after + CBOR {reason: duty_cycle, retry_after, level}), wired via resources/site.py:114-138 and transport.py:385-469; vectors coap_transport.json congestion_normal/elevated/critical/exhausted + load_shedding_503. Rust: duty_cycle.rs:125-127 same 500/800/950 + check_congestion_allows :280 + tx_queue.rs:675 pop_if_allowed, but NO server-side duty-cycle 5.03 CBOR builder (only generic service_unavailable rust/lichen-gateway/src/resources.rs:1137-1140 for capability-table-full). C DIVERGENT: lichen/subsys/lichen/coap/duty_response.c:33-42 uses 700/850/950 permille (header duty_response.h:44-46 even mis-cites the spec as <700/<850/<950); lichen_congestion_level_from_usage has zero production callers (tests only, lichen/tests/duty_response/main.c:132-144 pins the wrong values). Suggested placement: fix duty_response.c/.h constants to 500/800/950; wire congestion state into the C CoAP server request path; add a Rust server-side 5.03 duty-cycle builder mirroring py params.py:239-292. Related: b7z9.45 (C 5.03 emission + sender backoff).
close_reason: Fixed C threshold divergence: duty_response.c now 500/800 permille for Elevated/Critical (was 700/850), matching spec 07 10.2.4 (Normal <50%, Elevated 50-80%, Critical 80-95%, Exhausted >95%), Python params.py congestion_level, and Rust duty_cycle.rs congestion_level_from_permille. Header comment corrected (500/800, and <=950 critical). Also fixed a boundary divergence found in codereview: C used >=950 for Exhausted while spec ('>95%'), Python (>0.95), and Rust (>950) are all strict — now >950, so exactly-950 permille = Critical on all three. Test pins in lichen/tests/duty_response/main.c updated to the correct boundaries (499/500/799/800/949/950/951). duty_response host test builds+passes (ASan/UBSan). No other C site references old thresholds. 3x codereview delegated to kimi-k3: correctness PASS (found the >=950 vs >950 boundary issue, fixed), security PASS, edge PASS (verified all oracles + no other divergent C site). Remaining scope (C server-path wiring, Rust server-side 5.03 builder) filed as follow-up P2, related b7z9.45.
